dialogo.s: สวัสดี|sà-wàt-dii ครับ|kráp
คุณ|kun สบายดี|sà-baai-dii หรือ|rʉ̌ʉ ครับ|kráp
ผม|pǒm สบายดี|sà-baai-dii ครับ|kráp
แล้ว|lɛ́ɛo คุณ|kun ล่ะ|lâ ครับ|kráp
ผม|pǒm สบายดี|sà-baai-dii ครับ|kráp

e.pt: ผม é 'eu' só para homens; ดิฉัน é 'eu' para mulheres; คุณ é o 'você' polido; เขา serve para ele, ela ou eles (só pessoas). Analogia: o pronome 'eu' já vem com crachá de gênero.
e.en: ผม 'I' is used by men; ดิฉัน by women; คุณ is polite 'you'; เขา covers he, she and they (people only).

e.pt: สบายดี (estar bem) serve para estou, está, estamos: o sujeito vem antes e o verbo fica igual.
e.en: สบายดี works for am, is, are: the subject comes first and the verb stays the same.

notas.ex: ผม|pǒm สบายดี|sà-baai-dii

e.pt: Uma afirmação vira pergunta com uma palavra no fim. หรือ pede confirmação ('é mesmo?'); ล่ะ devolve a pergunta ('e você?'). Analogia: a palavra final é o ponto de interrogação falado.
e.en: A statement becomes a question with a final word. หรือ asks for confirmation; ล่ะ turns the question back ('and you?').

notas.ex: คุณ|kun สบายดี|sà-baai-dii หรือ|rʉ̌ʉ
